# Vendor libraries

`html2canvas.min.js` — screenshot tool (no CDN). Package: `html2canvas@1.4.1`.

`xlsx.full.min.js` — real `.xlsx` export. Package: `xlsx@0.18.5` via `npm run vendor:xlsx`.

`pdf.min.js` and `pdf.worker.min.js` — read text from a PDF in the browser. Package: `pdfjs-dist@3.11.174` via `npm run vendor:pdf`.
